strict_criterion: same initial metal-parent hash, substrate, CO count, environment and CO contact compositions; carbon RMS<=.5A/max<=1A; descriptive relaxed-site comparability, not proof of a controlled H-only perturbation

first_recommendation.calculation: CO-only counterpart of an existing repeatedly missed relaxed CO+H configuration
first_recommendation.hold_fixed: Same clean parent, cell, Cu/Au ordering, electronic/broadening settings, top-two absorber populations and CO count/contact motif as CO_H/CO_H_0p083_2CO_1H
first_recommendation.vary: Remove only isolated H from the XAS-used CO+H snapshot for an initial vertical diagnostic; then separately relax the CO-only counterpart under the same slab constraints. Label vertical and relaxed comparisons separately.
first_recommendation.decision_changing_result: If adding H gives a reproducible signed contribution above matched CO-only site variation and independently estimated measurement/registration uncertainty, pursue residual/contrast features; if not, collect complementary H-sensitive observables rather than lower the cutoff.
first_recommendation.reservation: Reserve the entire new clean/CO-only/CO+H family and all its layer/site views for prospective checks; never split a family between training and evaluation

measured_noise_or_registration_estimates: None supplied. 0.2eV grid spacing is sampling, not an uncertainty estimate. Synthetic perturbations above are sensitivity scenarios only.
additivity: CO-only template fit is a hypothesis, not a decomposition of actual relaxed mixture physics; actual shared-scale pair differences include slab/CO relaxation and site effects.
missing_pairs: No unmatched pair is promoted to an H-only contrast; nearest candidates are explicitly labeled.
